missingServerFacts: Full creature catalog and IDs/health/XP/attack/loot for every hunt
Full item stats, NPC prices, imbuement catalog, forge transaction rules
Exact per-monster loot probabilities and amount distributions
General level XP curve and skill progression curves
Actual physical attack/armor/defense, posture, distance accuracy and monster AI formulas
Authoritative spawn positions, map/tile layout and routes
Stamina regeneration rate, buy cost and death loss formulas
Server timing, reconnect/offline progression, anti-bot and multiplayer authority
reconstructionGuidance: Use spells, potions, ammo, visible prices and action-bar rules as factual configuration inputs. Implement independent authoritative gameplay logic.
For missing quantities either capture normal visible gameplay/UI or introduce clearly labeled original balancing values; do not label estimates exact.
The requested new RMT economy is separate design work; no original RMT logic or client code has been copied into this data file.
